rows.name:
This is Bajena Playhouse, my favorite
theater.

rows.label: tlk43200141_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I come here almost every day...
as long as my allowance lasts.

rows.label: tlk43200141_01_msg0003
rows.name:
I hope I'll get to walk out on that
stage someday as a leading lady!

rows.label: tlk43200141_01_msg0004
rows.name:
With Cole-san's wonderful scripts and
my acting, I want to excite everyone
and get their hearts racing.
